title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12662__PART_1_)
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 1) prescribes the guidelines for selection of vehicles for collection and transportation of solid wastes to processing or disposal site.

clause_2_normative_references.title: SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT COLLECTION EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS AND GUIDELINES

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
